When travelling, what people want most from Apple devices is just one accessory — not a whole pile of cables and wall-plug chargers. There are indeed plenty of options on the market, but most are bulky. Anker's Prime Qi2 25W Foldable 3-in-1 Wireless Charger targets exactly this problem: it folds completely flat, weighs about the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max, and can charge an iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods at the same time.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of the wireless-charging-capable Apple devices you already own.

A fully foldable three-in-one charger

The selling point of this product is exactly what the name suggests: it's small enough to fit in the palm of your hand, and can be folded flat to slip into a pocket, handbag or sling bag without taking up too much space. I've taken plenty of MagSafe stands travelling over the years, and almost every time they've been the bulkiest thing in my laptop bag.

Qi2 25W charging speeds

It's Qi2.2-certified and can deliver MagSafe charging speeds of up to 25W — far faster than the 7.5W ceiling most MagSafe accessories have been stuck at for years. Anker says it can get an iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in 26 minutes, up to five times faster than a standard 5W wireless charger. Real-world performance will vary depending on the iPhone model and temperature, but even getting anywhere near that level is already more than enough.

Faster MagSafe charging usually means more heat, so Anker has built in what it calls an AirCool temperature control system. It runs at just 19 decibels — so quiet you can barely hear it — and is designed to keep the phone below 98.6°F while sustaining the full 25W output. Heat is the enemy of long-term battery health and charging speeds, so if this feature actually delivers in everyday use rather than being a marketing gimmick, it's a genuinely useful selling point.

In terms of the three-in-one design, the main MagSafe charging puck charges the iPhone; on the side is an MFi-certified Apple Watch charger; and the base has a charging pad for AirPods. The core value of this kind of charging stand is this: one cable to the wall, replacing three separate chargers and three separate cables cluttering up your bag. Here's what's included in the Anker box:

  • Anker Prime wireless charging stand
  • 45W USB-C wall charger
  • 5-foot USB-C to USB-C cable

It's genuinely worth giving Anker credit for including a wall charger in the box, because a lot of products in this category assume you already have a powerful enough power brick. It also supports 110V–220V input, making it a great companion for international travel without needing to pack an extra voltage converter.

Verdict

Anker has put out plenty of three-in-one chargers over the years, but this one stands out from a crowded market thanks to its folding design. It actually solves the main reason most people don't bring a charging stand travelling: it's genuinely awkward to pack. This one isn't.

You can buy the Anker Prime Qi2 25W Foldable 3-in-1 Wireless Charger directly from Amazon or Anker's website.
